name: Sonozaki Akane
source:
She is [url=/c3788]Mion[/url] and [url=/c3814]Shion[/url]'s mother, but she was disowned from the Sonozaki family due to troubles with her husband.
She is an energetic and dynamic woman whose personality is like her daughters combined.
She and [url=/c3829]Ooishi[/url] seem to be on bad terms.

[Edited from [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Akane_Sonozaki]Akane Sonozaki[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
